gri_path: GRI 1: Section XVI Note 2(a) parts that are goods of 8532 go in 8532
missing_facts: Classify separately: valve plate, valve seat, valve body, protective cap (8413.91)
classification.rationale: First-named capacitor is itself a good of heading 8532, so Note 2(a) of Section XVI places it there; the capacitor type decides the subheading.
